verses.text: A psalm for giving thanks. Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth!
Serve the LORD with gladness. Come to him with singing.
Know that the LORD is God. He made us, and we belong to him. We are his people, the sheep he takes care of.
Come through his gates with thanks. Come into his courtyards with praise. Thank him and praise his name.
The LORD is good. His faithful love lasts forever. His faithfulness continues for all generations.
